events.text: Precursor prototype diesel locomotives ordered 1947-1954

evidence.quote: ordered by British Railways between 1947 and 1954

events.text: English Electric began building the 200 Class 40 locomotives.

evidence.quote: A total of 200 were built by English Electric between 1958 and 1962

events.text: First locomotive D200 delivered to Stratford depot.

evidence.quote: The first locomotive , D200 , was delivered to Stratford on 14 March 1958

events.label: service
events.text: D200 made its passenger debut on an express train.

evidence.quote: D200 made its passenger début on an express train from London Liverpool Street to on 18 April 1958

events.text: English Electric production of the class ended.

evidence.quote: A total of 200 were built by English Electric between 1958 and 1962

events.text: Final locomotive D399 delivered, completing the 200-unit order.

evidence.quote: the final locomotive , D399 , was delivered in September 1962

events.text: Seven Scottish-based D260-D266 locomotives converted to central headcode.

evidence.quote: In 1965 , seven of the first batch of locomotives

events.text: Nameplates gradually removed as Class 40s stopped working named trains.

evidence.quote: From approximately 1970 , with Class 40s no longer working these trains

evidence.quote: From 1973 , locomotives were renumbered to suit the TOPS computer operating system
